title: Seeking from data to data (avc-50fps-vbr-fhd)
product-requirement: Client must have access to expected events and properties while seeking between buffered regions.
specification: Terminals SHOULD implement Media Source Extensions API for VBR media (https://www.w3.org/TR/media-source-2/).
assertion: MediaSource and MediaElement events must emit in expected order, and properties must be of expected values throughout the seek.
